## Activity

During February 2025, Market Eye Clinic recorded 369 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading workload. Continued recording of capture activity will support routine monitoring of service performance at the clinic.

## Image quality

Of the 369 captures, 85 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 23.0 per cent. This level should be reviewed as part of the clinic’s routine quality monitoring. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that technical problems can be identified and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 80 referable results during the reporting month. The median lag from image capture to grading was 2 days. This indicates the typical interval between image acquisition and completion of grading. The clinic should continue to monitor grading turnaround alongside image quality and referable findings.
